title: 欢迎来到 Play Speak
desc: Emma 和 James 聊新品牌 Play Speak 的定位——从马克笔外贸到教玩具/幼儿园家具赛道的转型故事。

lines.speaker: emma
lines.en: Hi James, welcome to the first episode of Play Speak!
lines.cn: 嗨 James，欢迎来到 Play Speak 第一期！

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: Thanks Emma. Play Speak — interesting name. What is it about?
lines.cn: 谢谢 Emma。Play Speak——名字有意思。这是做什么的？

lines.speaker: emma
lines.en: It is an English learning show for foreign trade in the play industry — kindergarten furniture, playground equipment, that kind of thing.
lines.cn: 这是面向游乐行业外贸的英语学习节目——幼儿园家具、游乐设备这类。

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: Oh, like the Wenzhou Jiaoxia town industry? I know that place.
lines.cn: 哦，像温州桥下镇那个教玩具产业？我知道那地方。

lines.speaker: emma
lines.en: Exactly. Quinn, our host, just switched from stationery to kindergarten furniture. So we rebuilt the whole course around it.
lines.cn: 没错。我们的主理人 Quinn 刚从文具转到幼儿园家具。所以我们把整个课程重做了。

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: Smart move. The teaching toy market is huge in the Middle East and Southeast Asia.
lines.cn: 明智。教玩具市场在中东和东南亚很大。

lines.speaker: emma
lines.en: Right. We will cover EN71, EN1176, FSC wood certification, whole-kindergarten projects, all the real stuff.
lines.cn: 对。我们会讲 EN71、EN1176、FSC 木材认证、整园项目，全是实战。

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: Not just vocabulary, but how to actually talk to clients.
lines.cn: 不只是词汇，而是怎么真正和客户聊。

lines.speaker: emma
lines.en: Exactly. So whether you sell tables, slides or cat trees later, this is your playground.
lines.cn: 没错。所以不管你卖桌子、滑梯，还是以后卖猫爬架，这就是你的练习场。

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: Love it. Let us dive in.
